notes: Finishers now cut to an x-ray of the bone breaking, different for every style: a boxer's overhand breaks the jaw, a Muay Thai elbow fractures the skull, a karate spin kick snaps the neck, a BJJ armbar snaps the arm, a wrestler's powerbomb crushes the spine. Hold medium or heavy to charge it: the wind-up holds and a meter fills over your head, up to double damage; a full charge breaks guards, can knock down, and gets its own impact frame (careful, you're open while you charge). The CPU charges too. When you're hurt a red halo pulses in from the edges and the picture softens; when you're gassed your vision blurs and sweat drips on the screen, easing off as you recover (Settings → Hurt / tired vision). Fixed: a landed finisher sometimes left the opponent on 1 HP.
